चूलि

CŪLI . A sage. Once somadā, daughter of a gandharva women ūrmilā, looked after this sage and well pleased with her service he asked her what she wanted and somadā asked for a son by him. cūli gave her a spiritual son of his and the boy was named brahmadatta. This brahmadatta married the hundred hunch-backed daughters of kuśanābha. (Bāla Kāṇḍa, vālmīki rāmāyaṇa).

चुलुक

CULUKA . A river. People of ancient bhārata used to drink the water of this river. (Śloka 20, Chapter 9, bhīṣma parva).
